name: Clear Spider
description_en:
Clear Spider describes cloud inventory software spanning warehouse operations, vendor-managed inventory and field or mobile stock workflows. Its broader offering includes barcode-based tracking and optional devices such as kiosks and industrial vending.

The vendor-managed model is particularly relevant when a supplier replenishes stock held at a customer site. Visibility, ownership and replenishment responsibility must be agreed separately; a shared stock view alone does not establish consignment terms.
description_zh:
Clear Spider 提供云库存软件，覆盖仓库作业、供应商管理库存以及现场和移动库存流程，另有条码跟踪及自助终端、工业售货设备等选项。

供应商为客户现场库存补货时，其 VMI 模式尤其相关。双方仍需分别约定可见数据、货权和补货责任；共享库存视图本身并不构成寄售条款。

core_features.explanation_en: The VMI page describes supplier visibility into customer inventory/use and predefined replenishment purchase orders.
core_features.explanation_zh: VMI 页描述供应商查看客户库存与使用情况，并按预设规则补货采购。

core_features.explanation_en: The suite describes barcode, lot/expiry and serial tracking, kitting, returns and consignment workflows.
core_features.explanation_zh: 套件介绍条码、批次与有效期、序列号跟踪，以及组套、退货和寄售流程。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Pilot consumables at one customer site
sections.title_zh: 在一个客户现场试点耗材管理
sections.en: Agree which items the supplier can see and replenish, then establish locations, minimum/maximum levels and starting quantities. Record withdrawals and compare the resulting replenishment request with actual consumption. Include a return and a stock adjustment. This proposed pilot tests the supplier/customer handoff without assuming the vendor owns the goods.
sections.zh: 先约定供应商可查看和补充的商品，再建立地点、库存上下限及期初数量。记录领用后，将补货请求与实际消耗比较，并加入退货和库存调整。该试点建议用于检查供应商与客户交接，不预设货物归供应商所有。

sections.en: Warehouse, mobile, kiosk and vending capabilities appear across the public suite. Their presence on the website does not mean every package includes every device or workflow. A buyer should obtain a configuration covering scanning equipment, lot or serial rules, customer access and integration responsibility. Physical installation and labeling work also need an owner.
sections.zh: 官网套件列出仓库、移动、自助终端与售货设备能力，但不代表所有套餐均含全部设备和流程。采购应明确扫描设备、批次或序列号规则、客户访问及集成责任，并为实物安装和标签工作指定负责人。

sections.title_en: Use tier capacity to scope a quote
sections.title_zh: 根据方案容量确定报价范围
sections.en: The pricing page is quote-led rather than a public numeric tariff. Basic is shown for up to 10 users and 10 locations, Premium up to 250 each, and Ultimate for 250-plus. Reporting, training and support differ; 24/7 support is described with Ultimate rather than universally. Confirm hardware, integrations and onboarding as distinct quote items.
sections.zh: 价格页以询价为主，没有公开数值价目。Basic 标示最多 10 用户与 10 地点，Premium 最多各 250，Ultimate 为 250 以上。报表、培训和支持有差异；全天候支持列在 Ultimate，不能一概套用。硬件、集成和上线培训应在报价中单列确认。

sections.title_en: Check replenishment exceptions and access boundaries
sections.title_zh: 检查补货例外与访问边界
sections.en: The product is relevant to distributors and operations teams coordinating dispersed stock or customer-site supply. Test a supplier outage, an erroneous withdrawal and a customer location that must remain private. The public descriptions establish intended workflow, not measured inventory accuracy, offline operation or verified security isolation.
sections.zh: 产品适合协调分散库存或客户现场供货的经销商与运营团队。应测试供应商中断、错误领用，以及必须保持私有的客户地点。公开描述说明预期流程，不能证明实测库存准确率、离线能力或已验证的安全隔离。
